review_history.summary: Initial audit verified all main tables, raw ratings, limitations, post-experiment claims and 18 links; final open-series review was explicitly deferred.

review_history.scope: complete report including finalized open series
review_history.summary: Final audit adds open metrics/ratings/adjudication, frozen-oracle consistency, protocol deviation, all-28 completion, updated instruction language and all 23 links.

reviewed: research_compare/README.md against main results/metrics.json and runs.tsv, main_scores.json and both judges' five original main rating batches; open_results/metrics.json and runs.tsv, open_scores.json, both original open rating batches per judge, open_adjudications.json, frozen open oracles, public Git-command evidence, both tool-usage reviews, canonical skill wording and previously reviewed payload/scope evidence.
numeric_review: All 24 TSV rows match metrics and grading summaries. Recomputed both arms' token sums, means, medians, ratios, real-RTL-only totals and percentages, every case/repetition duration, and the 10-of-12 slower-pair count. README rounding is correct. All reported counters are known; all attempts completed and all three export integrity flags are true.
grading_review: Both original judges assign all 24 answers 8/8; therefore the table's per-arm 96/96 and real-RTL-only 64/64 are correct. Original criterion sums and explanation dimensions match the summary. The sole explanation exception is AXI MCP repetition 1 calibration=1/2, retained explicitly in the report; both judges agree.
accounting_review: Input plus output defines the total; cache and reasoning are treated as subsets and are not added again. Input-minus-cache is computed separately. CLI wait-time boundaries, excluded preparation costs and lack of monetary-cost conversion are stated accurately.
tool_count_review: Metrics confirm 213 MCP calls spanning all 13 tools, six failed calls, 18 project loads, and 80 versus 59 shell commands. Source-only attempts contain no MCP calls; all MCP calls target slang. The report distinguishes successful worker completion from tool/RTL errors and limits read-isolation claims to observed activity.
method_and_claim_review: Real RTL fragments and synthetic controls are separated. The requested gpt-5.6-terra/max identity, rejected GPT-6.1 request, unverified provider routing, small sample, shared startup instructions, cache dependence and lack of a bare-MCP arm are explicit. No unsupported positive superiority or statistical-significance claim was found. The open follow-up is labeled exploratory and is not mixed with main outcomes.
open_numeric_review: All four open TSV rows match metrics and grading summaries. Recomputed per-attempt values and rounding, final scores 13.5/16 versus 16/16, input-minus-cache 79182 versus 147662 (1.864843 times), output 32447 versus 35245 (1.086233 times), and summed duration 811.749968 versus 919.869520 seconds (+13.319317 percent). All counters are known and all four attempts completed with valid export checks. Together with the unchanged main series, all 28 scheduled attempts completed.
open_findings_and_adjudication_review: Both original judges support three AXI seeded findings in each arm and two versus three IDMA findings, hence 5/6 versus 6/6. The missed IDMA issue is ready_out versus ready_o. AXI raw scores 7.5 and 7 are preserved. The explicitly unblinded conservative final 7.5 follows frozen A4, where exact width is optional, while retaining the incorrect 128-versus-150 assertion as an explanation error and the false missing-fifo claim as partial A8 credit. The conditional IDMA atomicity discussion is not treated as a definite false defect. Frozen oracle files are unchanged; no post-hoc rubric replacement was found.
open_protocol_review: Verified the single AXI source-only git-status command has empty captured output. It is disclosed as an ancillary scope deviation, with no asserted successful repository read, demonstrated leak or post-hoc attempt exclusion. Metrics confirm 52 shell commands, 56 MCP calls and four failed calls. Recorded timestamps place the open series after main completion and show no more than two concurrent attempts.
final_conclusion_review: The task-dependent conclusion matches the evidence: factual main tasks show no quality improvement, while these two exploratory broken-RTL reviews favor MCP for one additional seeded finding and fewer unsupported assertions. The report bounds this to the observed cases, discloses the follow-up selection and single repetition, and does not establish broad superiority or isolate schemas from instruction effects. No comparison with a normal compiler CLI or other MCP server is claimed.
canonical_instruction_review: The added validity-review guidance asks for compiler diagnostics when reviewing local breakages and separates missing external components from dependencies not loaded. Task/conclusion-oriented wording is appropriate for open prose review. These are clearly proposed future workflow guidance, not measured effects of a revised skill. Both completed worker series retain the original frozen skill hash.
post_experiment_review: Payload reductions, canonical instruction changes and the C++ scope fix are explicitly separate from the frozen worker experiments. They are supported by compiler-only evidence and are not presented as measured improvements in agent answer quality, token use or elapsed time. Both worker series retain the original skill and binary.
links_and_format: All 23 local Markdown links in the completed README resolve. Main and open TSVs contain actual tab separators and respectively 24 and four data rows. Numeric precision and percentage rounding are consistent with source values.
reviewer_changes: This review JSON only; no report/source edits, model calls or subagents.
